stories.headline_en: Art Basel Paris Opens with Enhanced Security

stories.headline_en: Gowanus Open Studios marks 30 years

stories.headline_de: Krasner und Pollock im Met

stories.headline_en: Minoguchi's 'Die andere Seite' explores societal collapse
stories.headline_de: Minoghiuchis 'Die andere Seite' erforscht Gesellschaftszerfall
stories.summary_en: Mariko Minoguchi's film 'Die andere Seite' depicts a dystopian divided society where actress Nina Hoss fights for survival. The film explores themes of conflict and human endurance in a fragmented world.

stories.headline_en: Berlin Plans Return of Museum Sunday
stories.headline_de: Berlin plant Wiedereinführung des Museumssonntags
stories.summary_en: Berlin's coalition government is planning to reintroduce Museum Sunday, a program offering free or discounted museum entry. The initiative reflects cultural policy priorities in the city.
stories.summary_de: Berlins Koalitionsregierung plant die Wiedereinführung des Museumssonntags. Das Programm soll kostenlosen oder ermäßigten Museumseintritt ermöglichen.

stories.headline_en: B.E. Architecture designs privacy-focused Melbourne house
stories.headline_de: B.E. Architecture entwirft Privathaus in Melbourne
stories.summary_en: Casa Piva, designed by B.E. Architecture, is a new Melbourne residence organized around hidden courtyards to ensure privacy and seclusion. The house uses layered spaces to shield inhabitants from outside views.
stories.summary_de: Casa Piva von B.E. Architecture ist ein neues Wohnhaus in Melbourne, das mit verborgenen Innenhöfen Privacy und Abgeschiedenheit bietet. Die Struktur nutzt gestaffelte Räume zum Schutz vor Außenblicken.

stories.headline_de: Sculpture by the Sea 2026 eröffnet am Bondi
stories.summary_en: Australia's largest free outdoor sculpture exhibition returns to Sydney's 2km Bondi to Tamarama coastal walk with work by artists from around the world. The annual exhibition runs until 2 November.
